items.title: The first cohomology of the internal hom of a locally projective module vanishes on an affine
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for quasi-coherent modules on the small etale site of an affine scheme, with the first module locally projective, the first cohomology of the internal hom sheaf vanishes. The proof uses the definition of local projectivity on the etale site, reduces the internal hom to a direct summand of a product of copies of the structure sheaf, and then applies the exactness of the relevant sequence to conclude vanishing. The reduction of local projectivity to a statement about direct summands on the etale site is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 4802-4812 with the surrounding argument.
